subsystems.status: logic path represented; target configuration/readback and all fault modes OPEN
subsystems.evidence: 3 Q_CHG and 3 Q_DSG N-MOS (HYG022N10NS1TA) parallel banks have common drains at FET_MID; Q_CHG source side=BATT+_FUSED, Q_DSG source side=PACK+. BQ DFETOFF drives Q_DFETOFF; FET_RELEASE releases DFETOFF low, while reset/off allows R_DFETOFF_PU to pull it high if REG1 is alive.
subsystems.assessment: DFETOFFPinConfig=0x42 is the intended active-high BOTHOFF candidate that can disable CHG and DSG together; target write/readback and FET pin behavior are not verified. REG1 loss while BAT/REG18 remain present leaves the pull-up path unproven; do not claim universal fail-safe. NTC_CELL3 is intentionally on CFETOFF.

subsystems.status: electrical path represented; physical cutoff not proven
subsystems.evidence: Q_PRE1/Q_PRE2 are back-to-back P-MOS at BATT+_FUSED/QPRE_SW with common QPRE_SRC and QPRE_G; R_PRE is external 8.2Ω/300W from QPRE_SW to PACK+. R_QPRE_PU procurement BOM selects Yageo RC0603FR-074K7L (C99782), 4.7k, 1%, 0603, 100mW, 75V; R_QPRE_LIMIT 4.7k 1206.
subsystems.assessment: At pack low corner 22.5V, VCE(sat)=0.2V assumption and ±1% divider, |VGS|≈11.04..11.26V; at 37.8V, failed-open zener gives ≈19.1V below ±20V absolute rating, subject to actual transistor/zener limits. 4.7k pull-up reduces gate discharge RC versus old 10k by ≈2.13x. TPL5111 logic window ≈2.858s is not a max-rated physical current-zero guarantee. No independent PRE_OK/current-zero feedback; verify precharge current decay, MOSFET SOA, hot turn-off and timeout at bench. Official API and the current P1 attribute records agree with the 4.7k procurement selection; the stale 10k fields were confined to the previous derived pin-map JSON and have been corrected in the refreshed evidence.

subsystems.assessment: The BOM-listed candidate MPN for external NTC_CELL1/2/3 is Semitec 103AT-2; the BOM is pending quotation and does not evidence purchase. The legacy Vishay symbol/device/footprint is intentionally retained only as a CAD geometry carrier with Convert to PCB=false; this is not a purchasing MPN conflict. TI 18k model byte 0x07 for TS1/DCHG/CFETOFF is a candidate, not target readback. NTC_BOARD and NTC_MOS are Shiheng MF52A103F3950(A1), using its current Shiheng P477-4B custom R/T table and its extracted CSV; P163-6 remains historical only. P477-4B-based GPC input package is prepared, but coefficients have not been returned and no target-chip write/readback occurred. Raw DASTATUS data is confirmed signed 32-bit little-endian counts; exact DASTATUS6/7 byte offsets are in temperature_raw_window_candidate.json. Candidate open/short limits 250000/4700000 counts remain unqualified on target silicon and are not approved firmware constants. Physical probe/harness, temperature-trip behavior and fail-closed firmware implementation remain unverified.

subsystems.status: paper model only; 0..60°C CTR/dual-board margin not guaranteed
subsystems.evidence: VO617A-2X007T LED is fed from VOUT_5V via 510Ω and Q_LOAD_POWER_VALID_DRV to B0; gate defaults low by 100k. Opto output is a series link between LOAD_EN_BIAS_EXT and LOAD_POWER_VALID. External FOC interface is not BMS-owned.
subsystems.assessment: FOC two-board KCL corner model (SAFE_5V=4.75–5.25 V, A-only 1 kΩ bias, each A/B board 4.7 kΩ base and 100 kΩ pulldown) gives total optocoupler current about 1.046–1.425 mA. The worst-branch available base current is 0.5061 mA against about 0.4560 mA sink demand: 50.1 µA, approximately 11% paper margin under stated assumptions. This does not guarantee VO617A full 0–60°C CTR/VCEsat or actual dual-board rail/load corners; verify both boards together at temperature and supply extremes.

verificationPlan.acceptance: Only intended cell differential is lost; no cross-cell short or false-good status; F_CELL_Bn series path and external insulation withstand verified.

verificationPlan.test: VC filter and AFE threshold/config readback
verificationPlan.acceptance: Verify exact 9S enabled channels, unused VC parking, conversion polarity/gain and all safety thresholds from target readback.
Open F_CELL_B9, D_BAT, D_BREG and each regulator rail independently; confirm state defaults and no unintended charge/discharge.
All eight channels default off, one selected pair operates with correct direction/current, and any invalid cell data forces every EN low.
Across pack/temperature corners measure gate, branch current and current-zero time; no MAIN close until independently verified voltage match; any timer/MCU fault opens safely.

verificationPlan.test: DFETOFF BOTHOFF config and REG1 failure
verificationPlan.acceptance: Read back 0x42 setup; inject local reset/ALERT, REG1-only loss and BQ fault while BAT/REG18 remain up; prove both charge/discharge gates reach specified safe state.

Use pack prospective-current and vendor 37.8V DC TCC/total-clear data; verify 5A branches and 100A main fuse clear before every wire, holder, connector and board segment exceeds I²t/thermal limit; test below-rated fault behavior.

Raw encoding is already confirmed signed-32 LE counts; qualify the 250000/4700000-count candidate window on each configured channel, read back TI 0x07/A1 coefficients, inject open/short at each TS1/DCHG/CFETOFF/TS2/TS3, then verify fail-closed action, sensor identity, thermal coupling and hysteresis.
Prove all permits default low, AFE alert behavior, no stale permission, bus short/open/termination limits and isolation withstand.
At 0/60°C and SAFE_5V min/max, measure LED current, opto VCE, LOAD_POWER_VALID, each 4.7k base and collector clamp; validate all four dual-board load states and SAFE rail loss.

verificationPlan.test: PSU load and CTRL switch faults
verificationPlan.acceptance: Verify input range at 9S extremes, inrush, 5V rail/load short, converter temperature, CTRL open/ground/store/run and source fuse operation.
